# Versions of: Feature behaviour policies

1 published version of [Feature behaviour policies: taking the idea of agent behaviour policies down to every feature, bug fix and resource, so that a feature's policy is also its description, what changed is the difference between two policies, the gap between what a resource can do and what a feature needs is where the vulnerabilities live, and signed policies travelling with each request make a bug or an attack a path that was never supposed to exist](../feature-behaviour-policies.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
